response.sql: SELECT SUM(g - l) AS total_g_minus_l, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half WHERE w > 26;

assumptions.assumption: "Pass the 26-win mark" means strictly more than 26 wins (w > 26), so records with exactly 26 wins are excluded.
Records where g or l is NULL add nothing to the sum, as the request says to ignore missing values. They are still counted as records, because they meet the wins condition.

alternatives.interpretation: "Pass the 26-win mark" read as at least 26 wins (w >= 26).
alternatives.sql: SELECT SUM(g - l) AS total_g_minus_l, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half WHERE w >= 26;
